title: Which formation best fits this shape?
problem: Infer organization from positions rather than the team sheet.
methods: Centroid normalization and minimum-cost template assignment.
result: A clean formation board emphasizes the assigned roles.
status: Option A · Same players and window
notes: Best residual example from defensive 30-second windows; ten outfield players, at least 50 qualifying frames each. Four fixed templates and Hungarian squared-distance assignment. Player labels are assigned template slots, not reviewed role truth. Raw versus centered covariance ellipses appear as a small inset. RMS error is not a formation probability; not elastic EFPI inference. Alternative A: Role board. Same team, qualifying window, four candidate templates and assignment algorithm as the main deck; only the visualization differs. Role-board coordinates are schematic where shown; residual plots use observed centered medians.
